description: Create a Flux Kontext task on RunAPI (text to image). Returns a task id, status, and output URLs.

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. Default: 16:9. Declared type: string. Known values: "21:9", "16:9", "4:3", "1:1", "3:4", "9:16".

callback_url.description: Webhook URL for async notifications. Declared type: string.

enable_prompt_expansion.description: Expand the prompt with more detail. Default: false. Declared type: boolean.

enable_translation.description: Auto-translate non-English prompts. Default: true. Declared type: boolean.

model.description: RunAPI model slug for this model line.

output_format.description: Output format. Default: jpeg. Declared type: string. Known values: "jpeg", "png".

prompt.description: Image description (English only). Declared type: string.

safety_tolerance.description: Content safety threshold. 0-6 for generation, 0-2 for editing. Default: 2. Declared type: integer.

source_image_url.description: Source image URL for editing mode. Declared type: string.

wait.description: Poll until the task reaches a terminal status.

name: text_to_image
